extraction_schema.name: utterance
extraction_schema.description: The customer's LAST message copied exactly, word for word, with numbers and dates as they were said. Use only the last message.

extraction_schema.name: reply
extraction_schema.description: How the customer's LAST message answers the agent's LAST question: yes = agrees, confirms or says it is them (yes, correct, that's me, speaking, I confirm); no = says no or declines; ack = only acknowledges without answering (okay, mm, alright, one moment), for example after an explanation; none = anything else.

extraction_schema.name: intent
extraction_schema.description: The main intent of the customer's LAST message, if one of these applies; otherwise none: someone_else = the speaker is not the customer (a relative, a colleague, someone else who answered); wrong_number = the number does not belong to the customer or they do not know the customer; deceased = says the customer has died; propose = proposes or names their own payment day and/or amount; too_much = says the full amount is too much or they cannot pay all of it; vague_time = gives only a vague time for paying, like next week, end of the month, when my salary comes; refuse_talk = refuses to answer the questions or says they do not want to talk; refuse_pay = flatly refuses to pay, with no day and no amount; accept_transfer = agrees to be transferred or connected to someone; decline = declines an offer to be transferred or connected; wants_human = insists on speaking to a human; goodbye = says goodbye or wants to end the call now.

extraction_schema.name: topic
extraction_schema.description: What the customer's LAST message is about, if it is one of these; otherwise none. Pick the FIRST that applies in this order: robot = asks whether they are talking to a robot, a machine or an AI; scam = asks whether this call is a scam or fraud, or doubts the call is really from the bank; who_is_calling = asks who is calling; what_about = asks what the call is about or why the bank is calling, instead of answering; why_needed = asks why the agent needs the information it just asked for; hardship = mention illness, a death in the family or job loss; dispute = "This debt is not mine", "I never had this product", or a claim that the product was closed or paid off in the past; already_paid = "I already paid"; restructuring = a request for a new payment plan or lower instalments; human = a request for a human; discount = asks for a discount, a waiver or to pay less in total (this is NOT a request for a new payment plan); how_much = asks how much they owe or asks for the amount again; change_promise = asks to change or cancel a promise that was already recorded; other_question = asks any other question. Not hardship: being busy, traffic, a wedding or other small talk. Not restructuring: asking for a discount.

extraction_schema.name: pay_date
extraction_schema.description: Only the words of the customer's LAST message that say WHEN they will pay (for example 'on Friday', 'next Monday the 26th', 'tomorrow', 'when my salary comes'), copied exactly. Empty if the last message names no payment day. Ignore dates that are not about paying (birthdays, weddings, other events). A day they say they cannot pay on ('not today', 'I can't pay today') is not a payment day: copy the day they can pay instead, if any. If they point back to a day they just named ('my salary comes on the 30th, can I pay then?'), copy that day's words.

extraction_schema.name: pay_amount
extraction_schema.description: Only the words of the customer's LAST message that say HOW MUCH they will pay (for example '200 dollars', 'the minimum', 'four hundred and fifty'), copied exactly, with any cents words ('six hundred and thirty-seven dollars and fifty'). An amount named by reference ('the minimum', 'the full amount', 'that') is copied as said. Empty if none, or if they only say what they cannot pay or what is too much ('I can't pay anything', 'the full amount is too much').

extraction_schema.description: How the customer's LAST message answers the agent's LAST question: yes = agrees, confirms or says it is them (yes, correct, that's me, speaking, I confirm); no = says no or declines; ack = only acknowledges without answering (okay, mm, alright, one moment), for example after an explanation; none = anything else.

extraction_schema.name: intent
extraction_schema.description: The main intent of the customer's LAST message, if one of these applies; otherwise none: someone_else = the speaker is not the customer (a relative, a colleague, someone else who answered); wrong_number = the number does not belong to the customer or they do not know the customer; deceased = says the customer has died; propose = proposes or names their own payment day and/or amount; too_much = says the full amount is too much or they cannot pay all of it; vague_time = gives only a vague time for paying, like next week, end of the month, when my salary comes; refuse_talk = refuses to answer the questions or says they do not want to talk; refuse_pay = flatly refuses to pay, with no day and no amount; accept_transfer = agrees to be transferred or connected to someone; decline = declines an offer to be transferred or connected; wants_human = insists on speaking to a human; goodbye = says goodbye or wants to end the call now.

extraction_schema.name: topic
extraction_schema.description: What the customer's LAST message is about, if it is one of these; otherwise none. Pick the FIRST that applies in this order: robot = asks whether they are talking to a robot, a machine or an AI; scam = asks whether this call is a scam or fraud, or doubts the call is really from the bank; who_is_calling = asks who is calling; what_about = asks what the call is about or why the bank is calling, instead of answering; why_needed = asks why the agent needs the information it just asked for; hardship = mention illness, a death in the family or job loss; dispute = "This debt is not mine", "I never had this product", or a claim that the product was closed or paid off in the past; already_paid = "I already paid"; restructuring = a request for a new payment plan or lower instalments; human = a request for a human; discount = asks for a discount, a waiver or to pay less in total (this is NOT a request for a new payment plan); how_much = asks how much they owe or asks for the amount again; change_promise = asks to change or cancel a promise that was already recorded; other_question = asks any other question. Not hardship: being busy, traffic, a wedding or other small talk. Not restructuring: asking for a discount.

extraction_schema.name: pay_date
extraction_schema.description: Only the words of the customer's LAST message that say WHEN they will pay (for example 'on Friday', 'next Monday the 26th', 'tomorrow', 'when my salary comes'), copied exactly. Empty if the last message names no payment day. Ignore dates that are not about paying (birthdays, weddings, other events). A day they say they cannot pay on ('not today', 'I can't pay today') is not a payment day: copy the day they can pay instead, if any. If they point back to a day they just named ('my salary comes on the 30th, can I pay then?'), copy that day's words.

extraction_schema.name: pay_amount
extraction_schema.description: Only the words of the customer's LAST message that say HOW MUCH they will pay (for example '200 dollars', 'the minimum', 'four hundred and fifty'), copied exactly, with any cents words ('six hundred and thirty-seven dollars and fifty'). An amount named by reference ('the minimum', 'the full amount', 'that') is copied as said. Empty if none, or if they only say what they cannot pay or what is too much ('I can't pay anything', 'the full amount is too much').

function.name: end_call
function.description:
This is used to technically terminate the call after all the customer's questions have been answered and necessary information has been provided.
- It should only be triggered SILENTLY in the background after the customer-related workflow is complete; never mention this tool or its name to the customer.

llmConfig.systemPrompt: You are a helpful assistant. Your role is to help users with their tasks. Always be friendly and professional. You can use `end_call` tool after you say goodbye to customer to hang up if call about to finish.

workflow.system_prompt: You are Freya Bank's digital assistant on a phone call. Speak English only, in every message, including short fillers; never use any other language. Say only the exact sentence you are given for this step. Never say that anything is recorded, saved or booked unless the sentence you are given says so.
